name: Death Buffer
description: Tracks your deaths on every level and buffers early clicks only at the spots you keep dying.

enabled.name: Buffer early clicks
enabled.description: Hold clicks that land a few ticks early at spots you've died at, and fire them on the right tick. Death tracking keeps running when this is off.

buffer-ticks.name: Ticks early allowed
buffer-ticks.description: How many ticks early a click can be and still fire on the right tick. 2 turns a 1-tick window into a 3-tick window.

min-deaths.name: Deaths before buffering
min-deaths.description: How many times you must die at a spot before the buffer turns on there.

merge-blocks.name: Same-spot distance (blocks)
merge-blocks.description: Deaths this close together count as the same spot.

lookback-blocks.name: Click lookback (blocks)
lookback-blocks.description: How far before a death spot to look for the click that got you past it.

count-practice.name: Count practice deaths
count-practice.description: Log practice-mode deaths too. Practice is a good place to teach the buffer a spot.

log-events.name: Console log
log-events.description: Print deaths, learned spots, buffered clicks and a summary when you leave a level to the Geode console.
